description: This Java class 'BinaryProtocol' implements communication with a hardware controller over a custom binary protocol. It includes methods for connecting, reading and writing configuration data, sending commands, handling protocol switching, and managing transfers. It uses an underlying IoStream for serial communication and handles data buffering, CRC checks, and connection state.

classes.name: BinaryProtocol
classes.description: Handles communication protocol with the hardware controller, including connection management, data transfer, protocol switching, and configuration management.

methods.name: connectAndReadConfiguration
methods.description: Connects to the hardware controller using binary protocol and reads the configuration snapshot, then starts a thread to poll data.

methods.name: switchToBinaryProtocol
methods.description: Attempts to switch the controller to binary protocol mode.

methods.name: uploadChanges
methods.description: Uploads configuration differences to the controller and initiates burn.

methods.name: readImage
methods.description: Reads a configuration image from the controller.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes a block of data to the controller at a specified offset.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources.
